summary: Notes folder watcher: config watch_dirs/watch_scan_seconds; app/services/watcher.py (sync_watch_sources, scan_once, watcher_loop, list/delete); files.ingest_from_disk; app/api/watch.py + /api/files subject filter; main.py lifespan starts the loop guarded by a stop Event; tests.
final_report: T17.6 finalize (continuation session): verified the declared file set landed on disk and committed it as 6f03b56 (feat(watcher): notes folder watcher with config and scan api) on feature/latex-notes. config.py: watch_dirs (validation_alias SAGE_WATCH_DIRS, list) + watch_scan_seconds (validation_alias SAGE_WATCH_SCAN_SECONDS, default 300), SettingsConfigDict gains populate_by_name=True so tests can pass watch_dirs=... by field name. app/services/watcher.py: sync_watch_sources INSERT OR IGNORE per configured dir; list_watch_sources; delete_watch_source raises NotFoundError; scan_once walks the root recursively, hashes each allowed-extension file, ingests new (subject = first path segment), delete+re-ingests changed, skips unchanged, records missing-from-disk warnings; watcher_loop sleeps one full interval before the first scan (never races explicit POST /api/watch scans in tests) and iterates only enabled sources. files.py: FileService.ingest_from_disk(path, subject) resolving to absolute path and routing through save_upload with source_path+subject; list(subject=None) filters on subject. api/watch.py: GET/POST /api/watch, POST /api/watch/scan, DELETE /api/watch/{id}; POST /api/watch returns {source, scan} and scans immediately. api/files.py GET /api/files?subject=... main.py: lifespan starts watcher_loop with a stop Event, stops it on shutdown (10s timeout then cancel); watch router included. Two test bugs found and fixed inside the declared set before committing: (1) scan_once returned a summary without the warnings key while test_missing_from_disk_keeps_file_with_warning asserted summary['warnings'] — _finish_scan now returns {**summary, 'warnings': warnings} (the API response carries warnings; last_error still persists them to the row); (2) test_delete_watch_source_removes_row called _single_source with the fixture settings whose watch_dirs is [] so no source was synced — it now uses _watcher_settings with a tmp root.
